summary: SMARTCLOUT iteration 7 (frontend-only): real vendor logos (18x .webp) integrated in PartnersV2 scatter+grid and PartnersSection marquee, with text fallback for vendors without logo (proxmox, Huawei, Pure Storage, uptime DC, xorux). ALL 11 acceptance items PASS.
critical_code_review_comments: PartnersV2Section.jsx VENDOR_LOGOS map correctly gates vs text fallback. Vendor names must match exactly across CATEGORIES.partners[] and VENDOR_LOGOS keys — case-sensitive (e.g., 'DELL' vs 'Dell', 'vmware' lowercase, 'baramundi' lowercase). This is fragile if partners lists change; consider a normalizer helper or a single source-of-truth vendor registry.

PartnersSection.jsx uses 'Dell'/'VMware'/'Baramundi' (PascalCase) while PartnersV2Section.jsx uses 'DELL'/'vmware'/'baramundi'. Both work independently but naming inconsistency across sections is a maintenance risk.

sc-partners2__logo-img in App.css sets height 26px inside scatter/grid but no max-width constraint on some wide logos (e.g., commvault naturalWidth=1146px, aws=255px). object-fit:contain handles it visually but consider explicit max-width to guarantee identical pill widths.
App.css remains ~3633 lines. Recommend splitting into per-section CSS modules (partners.css, dividers.css, rack.css) for maintainability.

Random scatter pool.random selection: because pool is a flat list weighted by category size, more common vendors (DELL appears in 3 categories) are 3x more likely to show. Intentional weighting? If not, dedupe by name.
